The context.

An established payment platform must keep serving customers while its code, integrations, and application interfaces evolve. My contribution focused on reviewing backend code, supporting upgrades, and improving the maintainability and behavior of existing systems.

My contribution.

  1. Review developer code and support platform upgrades across existing mobile and C2C applications.
  2. Work on CodeIgniter backend services, payment-related fixes, and application maintenance.
  3. Improve API behavior and integration reliability for mobile and web consumers.
  4. Investigate transaction-flow defects and assist with production issues.
  5. Support practical modernization while respecting the needs of an operating remittance business.

The result.

  • Focused improvements to existing payment systems and application integrations.
  • Hands-on experience upgrading business-critical fintech software.
Good modernization starts with understanding what the existing platform already has to protect.
